name: Sharecare (2nd Position)
desc:
Forms Completion Specialist - Remote | Est. $17/hr | Medical Forms and Records, Some Inbound Calls, No Sales Expectations
Company: Sharecare
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Sharecare is a digital healthcare company, and this team handles medical paperwork for doctor's offices and their patients. You complete FMLA and short-term disability forms using standard answers for each type of practice, and you work to finish forms within 5 to 7 days after payment. You process medical record requests while following HIPAA rules, check the requesting party's information, and keep a log of every record released. You check the electronic medical record accounts so requests are handled on time, answer incoming calls from patients and offices, and log call details in an Excel tracking sheet. You also build good working relationships with the clients you support.

Soft Skills
- Attention to detail
- Organization and multitasking
- Friendly, patient-centered communication
- Respect for privacy
- Self-motivation
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment. Likely includes a typing test since 50 WPM is required.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting
Required Experience: 1 year in a medical records department or similar setting. Experience with FMLA and disability forms is required.
Preferred Experience: Familiarity with medical terminology and medical office processes

Required Skills:
- Type 50 words per minute
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel
- Excellent organization and multitasking
- Able to use a fax, copier, and scanner
- Quick learner of new equipment and processes
- Self-motivated team player with strong customer service
- Excellent communication skills

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has worked in medical records, a doctor's office, or with FMLA or disability paperwork
- Types fast and accurately
- Knows medical terms and HIPAA privacy rules
- Likes detail work with some phone contact

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has no medical records or forms experience
- Types under 50 WPM
- Struggles with accuracy or deadlines
- Wants a job with no phone contact
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening goes, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- FMLA forms
- Short-term disability
- Medical records
- Release of information
- HIPAA and HITECH
- Electronic medical records (EMR)
- Medical terminology
- Typing 50 WPM
- Microsoft Word and Excel
- Customer service

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your experience with FMLA or disability forms.
- What do you know about HIPAA and why does it matter with medical records?
- How do you keep track of forms with different deadlines?
- Tell us about a time you caught a mistake before it caused a problem. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you juggled several tasks at once. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: Est. $16 to $19/hr, working estimate $17/hr. Pay isn't listed in the posting. This estimate is based on salary site data for medical records coordinators (median about $17.65/hr) and similar remote medical records roles around $19/hr. Exact pay will be discussed in interview/offer stage.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: Basic benefits: insurance options, PTO, possible 401k
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This is a no-sales, mostly paperwork job in healthcare with some phone contact. Experience with FMLA or disability forms and 1 year in medical records are required, so it fits participants who already have medical office or records experience. Typing speed of 50 words per minute is required, so have participants take a typing test first. The posting asks for HIPAA and HITECH compliance. Sharecare uses E-Verify. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Forms Completion Specialist → Senior Forms Completion Specialist → Release of Information Specialist → Lead ROI Specialist → Health Information Management Supervisor. This role builds FMLA and disability forms, medical records, HIPAA, and data accuracy skills.
